newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia to end some Mazda tech transfers.
newsitem.headline: Kia to end some Mazda tech transfers.

text.p: South Korea's Kia Motors Corp will not extend agreements to import automobile production technology for three models from Japan's Mazda Motor Corp, a Kia spokesman said on Friday.
The three cars are Kia's Capital, Concord and Pride, he said.
"We plan to replace these models with new ones made with our technology," he said.
The current contracts with Mazda, which were in effect for 30 years, will end between October and December, he said.
"This will result in savings in our royalty payments," he said, but declined to give a savings figure.
Mazda will continue to transfer technology for two Kia passenger car models -- Potentia and Avella -- and one truck model -- Jumbo Titan.
